name: Quarterly sales
query:
SELECT
    YEAR(b.posting_date) AS "YEAR",
    CASE
        WHEN QUARTER(b.posting_date) = 1 THEN 'Jan to Mar'
        WHEN QUARTER(b.posting_date) = 2 THEN 'Apr to Jun'
        WHEN QUARTER(b.posting_date) = 3 THEN 'Jul to Sep'
        WHEN QUARTER(b.posting_date) = 4 THEN 'Oct to Dec'
    END AS "Quarter",
    ROUND(SUM(b.net_total), 2) AS "Item Total",
    ROUND(SUM(b.`grand_total` - b.`net_total`), 2) AS "Tax",
    ROUND(SUM(b.grand_total), 2) AS "Grand Total"
FROM 
    `tabPOS Invoice` b
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
    rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
)
WHERE
    b.`branch` = %(branch)s
    AND b.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid") 
    AND b.`docstatus` = 1 
    AND YEAR(b.`posting_date`) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    AND (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND b.`posting_date` = b.`posting_date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(b.`posting_date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND b.`posting_date` = b.`posting_date`)
    )
GROUP BY 
    YEAR(b.`posting_date`), QUARTER(b.`posting_date`)
ORDER BY 
    YEAR(b.`posting_date`), QUARTER(b.`posting_date`) DESC;
